name: iRobot
headline: iRobot ownership after Picea, Roomba portfolio and operating reset
description: A source-backed profile of iRobot's 2026 transition to private Picea ownership, current leadership, U.S. operating base and renewed floorcare portfolio.
metaDescription: iRobot company profile: current Picea ownership, private status, leadership, Roomba products, manufacturing relationship and strategy.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with iRobot or Picea. Public-company and restructuring facts are dated because iRobot became privately held in January 2026.

ownership.summary: iRobot became privately held and wholly owned by Picea on January 23, 2026, after a U.S. court-supervised restructuring. iRobot's filing defines Picea collectively as Shenzhen PICEA Robotics Co., Ltd. and its wholly owned subsidiary Santrum Hong Kong Co., Limited. The old public equity was cancelled, and a January 26 Form 15 began terminating or suspending iRobot's former SEC registration and reporting obligations. The transaction announcement describes iRobot Safe Corporation as a separate U.S.-based subsidiary responsible for protecting U.S. consumer data, with independent U.S. governance.
ownership.parentCompany: Picea (Shenzhen PICEA Robotics Co., Ltd. and Santrum Hong Kong Co., Limited collectively)

leadership.name: Gary Cohen
leadership.context: Continued as CEO through the January 2026 transaction and was identified as CEO in iRobot's March 2026 Roomba Mini launch.

productPortfolio.name: Roomba robot vacuums and vacuum-mop robots
productPortfolio.positioning: The core home-robotics franchise, covering compact robots, lidar-equipped systems and docked vacuum-and-mop configurations.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Supports tiered Roomba assortments across compact, lidar and docked cleaning formats.

productPortfolio.name: Roomba Electro Plus
productPortfolio.positioning: A user-operated five-in-one hard-floor cleaner announced in July 2026, extending the Roomba name beyond autonomous robots.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Creates a manually operated hard-floor category that should be planned separately from autonomous Roomba robots.

productPortfolio.name: Roomba Home App
productPortfolio.positioning: The current consumer app for newer Roomba families; iRobot's app page says other models continue to use iRobot Home (Classic).
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Requires model-level app compatibility checks for setup and after-sales support.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Before the restructuring, Picea was iRobot's primary contract manufacturer and later its secured lender; the January 2026 transaction converted that supplier-creditor relationship into ownership.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm the current manufacturing agreement and manufacturer for the contracted Roomba model.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: iRobot's completion announcement says Picea has research, development and manufacturing operations in China and Vietnam.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify the exact factory and country of origin for the contracted SKU.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The same announcement says iRobot remains headquartered in Bedford, with engineering, product development, marketing and corporate functions anchored in the United States.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm which entity owns product, software and service responsibility in the target market.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Picea ownership does not establish one factory for every Roomba model; product labels and regulatory documents remain necessary for model-level origin.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Check product labels and regulatory documents for the exact model's manufacturer and origin.

marketsChannels.evidence: iRobot says it has sold more than 50 million robots since introducing Roomba in 2002.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Use current regional sell-through and installed-base data for assortment planning.

marketsChannels.evidence: Its July 2026 portfolio announcement covered five new Roomba robots and a user-operated hard-floor cleaner for North America, showing active product operations after the restructuring.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm model launch timing and channel availability in the target North American market.

marketsChannels.evidence: The company continues to use its direct website and retail partners, while product range, timing and service coverage vary by market.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm local seller authorization, product range, launch timing and service coverage.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: iRobot retains one of the category's best-known consumer names, a large installed base and U.S.-anchored product and software functions. Picea ownership can tighten the link between product development and Asian manufacturing, but the company must rebuild feature, cost and channel competitiveness after restructuring while Roborock, ECOVACS and Dreame sustain rapid launch cycles and broad multifunction-dock portfolios.
